title: Bulk Close on many selected tickets fails with 500 errors and shows a wrong result
env: NDC-Staging · staging-desk.taviportal.com · ndc-staging-owner · Edge headless + API · 60 tickets "QA RT17 2823 01–60" + 1 control in a private view (deleted at cleanup)

panels.caption: Whole view selected (60) › Close › confirm "Close 60 tickets"
Result: "0 updated, 60 failed." — but 10 tickets did close (read back by API)
After the 3rd run on the same view, some tickets are still Open (e.g. QA RT17 2823 57)
Network: each ticket gets its own POST /desk/tickets/{id}/close; many return 500. The same tickets close by API (200).

rows: Select the whole view (60) › Close › Close 60 tickets

Run Close again on the same view (2nd, 3rd time)
